about: Shared terminal engine conformance (libghostty plan G6): each case feeds `input` (bytes, UTF-8) to a fresh engine of `cols` x `rows` (default 20 x 4, 100 lines of history) and checks `expect`. Cases without `engines` are the baseline every engine must pass; cases with `engines` are fidelity extras those engines must pass, recorded but not required for the others. Keys: contents (screen as shown, trailing blanks trimmed), cursor [row, col] or null, shape, effects (bell, clipboard:<sel>:<b64>, notify:<body>; compared as a set: engines may queue different kinds in a different order), modes, cells (text, fg idx:/rgb:, mods), scrollback_len, scrolled_back {offset, contents}, rows {row: text} and wrapped {row: bool} and starts {row: [cell of each char]} by history row number, links [{row, col, uri}]. Run by src/tui/emulator.rs tests. `then` {input, rows, then?} feeds more output to the same engine and checks rows again (history rows keep their numbers as older ones are dropped).
